state_summary.problem: At 844x390 the billiards table collapses to an approximately eight-pixel wide vertical strip, hiding balls and pockets.
state_summary.expected: Landscape players can see and aim on a usable table while reading the turn banner.
observed: Independent reviewer viewed final-four-widths/027-844-playing.png and reported an 8x180px strip.
Root also viewed the screenshot and confirmed no usable felt or balls are visible.
The grid table wrapper has max-width and auto margins but no definite width; canvas intrinsic resize feeds back into its shrink-to-fit width.
unknown: Whether giving the wrapper an explicit full available width restores the intended landscape aspect ratio.
